description: Source code for eswifi driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing Wi-Fi management, including scan, connect, disconnect, and AP mode functionalities.

methods.name: eswifi_reset
methods.description: Resets the eswifi device by toggling GPIOs and requesting status.

methods.name: __parse_ssid
methods.description: Parses SSID string from response.

methods.name: __parse_scan_res
methods.description: Parses scan result line into wifi_scan_result structure.

methods.name: eswifi_at_cmd_rsp
methods.description: Sends AT command and processes response.

methods.name: eswifi_at_cmd
methods.description: Sends AT command without expecting response data.

methods.name: eswifi_by_iface_idx
methods.description: Returns eswifi device instance by interface index.

methods.name: __parse_ipv4_address
methods.description: Parses IPv4 address from response string.

methods.name: eswifi_scan
methods.description: Performs Wi-Fi scan and invokes callback with results.

methods.name: eswifi_connect
methods.description: Connects to Wi-Fi network using stored credentials.

methods.name: eswifi_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: eswifi_status_work
methods.description: Periodically checks Wi-Fi status and updates events.

methods.name: eswifi_request_work
methods.description: Handles queued requests like connect, disconnect, scan.

methods.name: eswifi_get_mac_addr
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of the device.

methods.name: eswifi_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, resets device, sets MAC.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_iface_status
methods.description: Provides current Wi-Fi interface status.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_scan
methods.description: Starts Wi-Fi scan.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects Wi-Fi.

methods.name: __eswifi_sta_config
methods.description: Configures station parameters for connection.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_connect
methods.description: Initiates Wi-Fi connection.

methods.name: eswifi_async_msg
methods.description: Sends asynchronous message to offload.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_ap_enable
methods.description: Enables Wi-Fi Access Point mode.

methods.name: eswifi_mgmt_ap_disable
methods.description: Disables Wi-Fi Access Point mode.

methods.name: eswifi_init
methods.description: Initializes the eswifi device driver.

methods.name: eswifi_get_type
methods.description: Returns the type of network interface (Wi-Fi).
